login.title: Log in or sign up
login.intro: Use your phone number. New to Gwani? We’ll set up your account after you verify it.
login.emailNote: For customer accounts that added an email.

phone.label: Phone number
phone.hint: Nigerian mobile: 070, 080, 081, 090 or 091. You can start with 0 or +234.

otp.smsNote: We’ll text you a {{length}}-digit code. Standard SMS rates may apply.
otp.expired: That code has expired. Send a new one.
otp.resendIn: Didn’t get it? You can resend in {{seconds}} s.

password.label: Password
password.rules: At least {{min}} characters; longer, with a mix of letters, numbers and symbols, is stronger.

dev.demoHint: Pick one to fill its number, then use the test code. Aisha can also use email aisha@example.com / minna-demo-2026.

signup.expiredBody: Enter your number again to get a new code.
signup.inviteExists: Your trade association already created your profile.

setup.emailHint: For receipts. You can verify it later and use it to sign in.
setup.kindLegend: What kind of vendor are you?

check.name: Enter your name.
check.town: Enter your town or a landmark.
check.terms: Accept the provider terms to continue.

tip.searchText: Find plumbers, tailors, groceries and more in your LGA.
tip.badgesText: ID- and Trade-Verified vendors have been checked by Gwani.
tip.payText: Online payments are held until the work is done.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.intro: Enter the email on your customer account. Vendors, riders and staff sign in with their phone number.
forgot.sent: If {{email}} belongs to a Gwani customer account with a verified email, we’ve sent a link to reset the password. It works for 30 minutes.

addRole.heading: Add a role
addRole.keepNote: You’ll keep everything you have now and can switch roles from the menu.
addRole.allBody: Switch between them from the menu.

guard.addRoleBody: Add the {{role}} role to your account to use it.
guard.staffOnly: Only Gwani staff can open this.

security.title: Email and password
security.intro: You sign in with your phone number. Add an email to get receipts.
security.introCustomer: You sign in with your phone number. Add an email to get receipts and, if you like, sign in with it and a password.
security.phoneOnlyNote: Email sign-in is for customer-only accounts. Because you also use Gwani as a provider, rider or staff member, keep signing in with your phone.

toast.passwordSet: Password set. You can now sign in with your email.

terms.title: Provider terms
terms.subtitle: Placeholder: the final terms will be published here
terms.placeholder: These are placeholder terms for the demo.
terms.item1: The details on your profile are yours and are correct.
terms.item2: You quote honestly, turn up when booked, and keep customers’ details private.
terms.item3: Online payments are held in escrow and released when the work is done, minus Gwani’s commission.
terms.item4: Your subscription renews monthly; your profile is restricted if it lapses.

rider.subtitle: Rider dashboard
rider.comingSoonText: Soon you’ll see orders to deliver in your area here. We’ll let you know when it’s ready.

claim.title: Claim your Gwani profile
claim.alreadyBody: This profile has been claimed. Sign in with your phone number to manage it.
claim.cancelledBody: Contact your association if you think this is a mistake.
claim.expiredBody: Ask your association or Gwani to send a new one.
claim.wrongAccount: This invitation is for {{phone}}, but you’re signed in as {{name}}.
claim.intro: {{association}} added {{business}} to Gwani. Customers can’t see it until you claim it. This link works until {{date}}.
claim.name: Name
claim.termsLine: I accept the <termsLink>provider terms</termsLink>, and my association pays for my plan under its bundle.
claim.yearsInvalid: Years of experience should be a whole number.
claim.acceptTerms: Accept the provider terms to continue.
